# Brigade Banashankari

> Brigade Banashankari is a pre-launch apartment community by Brigade in Uttarahalli, South Bengaluru, near Banashankari: 600 homes (50 of 1 BHK, 50 of 2 BHK, 400 of 3 BHK and 100 of 4 BHK) in two towers of four basements, ground and 40 floors on about 9 acres (9 acres 1 gunta), with a clubhouse building, about 4.8 acres of landscape and 1,000 parking spaces. Turahalli Forest is about 1.5 km away. Areas and prices will be announced at launch.

Prices, areas and other charges will be announced at launch. Stamp duty and registration are extra.

## Amenities

Life at Brigade Banashankari centres on a clubhouse in a building of its own, five floors above ground, and on about 4.8 acres of landscaped open space, more than half the site, with gardens and shaded paths between the two towers. Turahalli Forest, about 1.5 km away, and Uttarahalli Lake add green space beyond the gates.

- Clubhouse in its own building
- Clubhouse lounges
- About 4.8 acres of landscape
- Landscaped gardens
- Shaded walking paths
- Outdoor spaces for gatherings
- 1,000 parking spaces
- Four basement levels

## Location

Brigade Banashankari is in Uttarahalli, South Bengaluru, near Banashankari, with Turahalli Forest about 1.5 km away and Uttarahalli Lake about 3.4 km. Gleneagles BGS Hospital is about 5.1 km away, Forum South Bengaluru about 5.9 km, Global Village Tech Park about 6.1 km and the Kengeri Bus Terminal metro station about 7.4 km. Distances are approximate driving distances; open the map for directions and live travel times.

## Notes for accuracy

- Prices and areas will be announced at launch. Do not quote a price.
- The project has no announced name; this site calls it Brigade Banashankari. The floor plan images are illustrative layouts.
- Distances are approximate driving distances.
- This website is operated by a channel partner and is not the official website of Brigade Group, whose website is https://www.brigadegroup.com.
